categories.main_business_segments: Yimikang Tech.Group Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the digital infrastructure sector, focusing on four main business segments: key equipment manufacturing (including precision air conditioning and cooling systems), intelligent engineering services (digital infrastructure lifecycle services and smart hospital solutions), software business (data center operation management and energy-saving solutions), and smart services (operation and maintenance, energy efficiency upgrades). The company provides comprehensive solutions covering the entire lifecycle of digital infrastructure, including design, construction, equipment supply, software management, and maintenance services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in advanced temperature control technologies for digital infrastructure, including air cooling, water cooling, and liquid cooling systems such as Nexliq2.0 liquid cooling and integrated fluorine pump systems. It employs intelligent manufacturing with robotic production lines and automated CNC equipment to enhance production efficiency and product quality. The company also develops digital twin technology, BIM-based design verification software, AIoT platforms, and modular prefabricated data center solutions, emphasizing innovation in energy-efficient and green cooling technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yimikang serves a broad range of customers including government entities, telecommunications operators, internet giants, financial institutions, and industries requiring data centers and digital infrastructure. Its markets include data centers (cloud, enterprise, edge, and supercomputing centers), smart hospitals, intelligent manufacturing, and smart cities. The company also targets strategic regions involved in China's 'East Data West Computing' initiative and overseas markets in Southeast Asia and the Middle East.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant presence in key digital infrastructure clusters such as Zhongwei, Qingyang, Tianfu, Shaoguan, Yangtze River Delta, and Zhangjiakou. It has expanded its footprint internationally, delivering projects and establishing operations in Southeast Asia countries including Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam, the Philippines, and in the Middle East, particularly Oman, aligning with the Belt and Road Initiative.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yimikang operates across the midstream and downstream segments of the digital infrastructure supply chain. It manufactures critical temperature control equipment, provides engineering design and construction services, develops software for infrastructure management, and offers ongoing operation and maintenance services. This integrated approach positions the company as a full lifecycle solution provider within the digital infrastructure ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on innovation in green and intelligent digital infrastructure solutions, emphasizing energy-efficient temperature control technologies and digital transformation services. R&D priorities include developing next-generation cooling systems (e.g., dynamic dual-cold source wind walls, integrated fluorine pump units), liquid cooling solutions, modular prefabricated data centers, and AIoT-based digital operation platforms. It actively participates in national initiatives supporting AI, big data, and digital economy growth, and invests in talent development and digital twin technologies to enhance project delivery and asset management.
categories.revenue_model: Yimikang generates revenue primarily through product sales of precision air conditioning and cooling equipment, engineering construction contracts for digital infrastructure projects, software licensing and service fees for data center management platforms, and ongoing smart operation and maintenance services. The company also earns income from energy-saving retrofit projects and leasing of assets related to its infrastructure solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading domestic provider of comprehensive digital infrastructure lifecycle solutions with a strong brand and extensive industry experience. It competes with other specialized equipment manufacturers, engineering service providers, and software firms in the digital infrastructure and data center sectors. Yimikang differentiates itself through its integrated four-segment business model, advanced green cooling technologies, and participation in national standards development, securing a competitive edge in the Chinese market and expanding internationally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Yimikang reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.14 billion, representing a 42.84% year-over-year increase. Despite a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 87.14 million, the company reduced its losses significantly compared to the previous year. The company’s total assets stood at RMB 1.68 billion with a slight growth of 3.41%. Cash flow from operating activities improved markedly, turning positive with RMB 103.16 million. The company continues to invest in R&D, allocating around 3.76% of revenue to innovation activities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yimikang emphasizes its unique value proposition as a one-stop provider of green, energy-efficient, and intelligent digital infrastructure solutions covering the entire lifecycle from design to operation. Its product differentiation lies in advanced temperature control technologies, including innovative liquid cooling and modular prefabricated data centers, combined with integrated software and smart services. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, comprehensive industry standards participation, and extensive customer trust underpin its competitive advantage and ability to meet evolving digital economy demands.
